description: Known benign patterns written by analysts in plain language (doc 6.4). Added by pull request only, reviewed by a second owner (R7). `applies_to` is optional and filters in code which descriptions are sent: `agents` (Wazuh agent names) and `rule_ids`; a pattern without it is sent with every alert. `verify` is optional and is evaluated in code, never by Jev: type `source_ip_in` holds when the address in the alert field named by `field` (for example `data.srcip`) is inside the CIDR list file named by `list` (a path in this folder). Only that field is read. No alert is closed automatically unless a verify block of an applicable pattern holds (gate G4).

patterns.description: Synthetic test events written by the asox-test program on the lab agent, fired on purpose by the SOC team to test the pipeline.
